free_resources.title: Buddhism and Recovery Support Group
free_resources.description: A free, peer-led group on Zoom for people in recovery from any kind of addiction. Each meeting opens with a period of sitting meditation, then a talk or reading on the Dharma and recovery, then open sharing. Everyone in recovery is welcome.

left_out: Support Group for Persons with Life Threatening Illnesses and Chronic Health Challenges (https://www.insightmeditationcenter.org/life-threatening-illnesses-and-chronic-health-challenges/): passes the 12 Nov health rule (no claim to treat), but the listing has 4 of 5 free resources, so only one group fits; the recovery group was chosen as it includes meditation and Dharma teaching.
flags: Free resource cap: this brings the listing to 5 of 5 free resources (per its plan); please check live.
The group's own page says weekly on Sunday evenings; IMC's Support Groups page says the second Sunday of the month (facilitator Jennifer Lemas). The description gives no frequency.
Peer-led by volunteers, not by an IMC teacher; it is one of IMC's own listed programmes.
